issue: सुख पहुँचती हो माँ अम्बे — पहुँचती ('arrive') does not take सुख as an object, and the half has 15 mātrās against its fellows' 16; पहुँचाती ('bring [happiness]') fits both. But Drik Panchang, Aaj Tak and InstaAstro all print पहुँचती, so no witness gives the other form.
our reading: सुख पहुँचती हो माँ अम्बे (as printed)
